title: Comlink
caption: Comlink (V)
game_text: Deploy on an Imperial. While present at a battleground (or deployed on Emperor), Imperials lost from Life Force satisfy an additional 2 Force loss. If Luke deploys using your objective, he deploys to Vader’s site (if possible). Once per game, may ▲ Rise, My Friend.
lore: Hand-held communication device. Military comlinks have scrambling and variable frequency programming for secure communication during battles or emergencies.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique (no dot on slip or printed card; wiki: Unrestricted). Green Device frame, banner DEVICE. Curly apostrophe in Vader’s; ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. No inline icons. Lore matches the scan. Only a 350 px scan; copyright 1995 (Premiere) by set, not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 6 only (VB6 -pre, 350 px) — note GEMP's VB6 Comlink (V) carries different text from this slip.
